We need to determine SMILES of an organic molecule given only "sample of an organic molecule" but no data. Likely we need to use measurement tools to get spectra. We need minimal but sufficient analysis. So we should start with mass spectrometry to get molecular weight and formula. Then maybe NMR to deduce structure. Use tools: mass_spectrometry_spectra, then get formula via get_formula_from_smiles? Actually we need formula from mass. There's no tool to get formula from mass directly. Could use retrieve_dbe_formula to compute DBE after we have formula. But we need formula. Could use obtain_isomers_from_molecular_formula after we guess formula. But we need formula first.

Maybe we can use mass_spectrometry_spectra to get m/z peaks. Then we can infer molecular ion. Let's run mass_spectrometry_spectra.
